claim.claim-text: a chassis (12) and an equipment rack (14), wherein the chassis (12) has opposite front and rear ends (24, 26) that are spaced apart from one another in a longitudinal direction, the chassis (12) configured to be disposed in the equipment rack (14), and wherein the equipment rack (14) comprises two vertical rails (16A, 16B) that extend vertically and include a series of apertures (18) for facilitating attachment of the chassis (12) inside the equipment rack (14); the fiber optic apparatus further comprising:

2. The fiber optic apparatus of claim 1, wherein each of the plurality of fiber optic equipment trays (20) is independently translatable about the chassis (12) during operative access of the fiber optic modules (22).

3. The fiber optic apparatus of any of claims 1 or 2, further comprising at least one module locking feature disposed adjacent a front end of each of the plurality of fiber optic equipment trays (20), each of the at least one module locking feature configured to interlock a fiber optic module (22) to a fiber optic equipment tray (20) among the plurality of fiber optic equipment trays (20) when the fiber optic module (22) is disposed adjacent the front end of the fiber optic equipment tray (20).

4. The fiber optic apparatus of any of claims 1 to 3, wherein each of the plurality of fiber optic modules (22) comprises fiber optic adapters (64) disposed on a front end (66) of the fiber optic module (22) and a fiber optic adapter (70) disposed on a rear end (73) of the fiber optic module (22), and two sides (74A, 74b) on which the module rails (52A, 52B) are disposed.
5. The fiber optic apparatus of claim 4, wherein the fiber optic adapters (64) disposed on the front end (66) of each fiber optic module (22) accept duplex LC fiber optic connectors (68).

6. The fiber optic apparatus of any preceding claim, wherein the chassis (12) is a shelf for the fiber optic equipment rack, the shelf being 4.45cm in height, and wherein the chassis (12) supports three fiber optic equipment trays (20) with each tray stacked on top of each other.
